OpenAI Seeks Massive Funding Amid AI Development Debate

OpenAI is reportedly seeking up to $11.9 billion in financing, with SoftBank involved in a significant loan arrangement. This pursuit of substantial capital comes as some executives express concerns about the escalating risks associated with rapid AI development and suggest slowing its pace. The CEO of Ziff Davis has publicly stated that if OpenAI can secure vast sums for data centers, it should also allocate funds to publishers.
